title: Python: bare assert without messages (~19 files)
description: ~19 Python files use bare 'assert x' without descriptive messages. When these fire, test output shows only 'AssertionError' with no explanation of the violated invariant. An AI watching tests cannot diagnose the root cause. Fix: replace with 'assert x, "description"' or explicit 'if not x: raise AssertionError("...")'. Files include dao_manager.py, schc/reassembly.py, and others.
